scope: AP-focused residual ranker over frozen dense-Prithvi development features

folds.selection_order: cross-predict 3 from 4 and 4 from 3; freeze strength; only then fit 3+4 and evaluate 2

architecture.floor: exact float64 current cross-fitted scene probability converted to logit
architecture.inputs: 670 features: current score plus all frozen dense representation/mask statistics except the already rejected BCE scene residual
architecture.scaling: training-only median and normalized IQR; sentinel absolute values >=1000 treated as missing; clipped to [-8,8]
architecture.head: 670 -> 96 -> 32 -> bounded scalar logit residual, LayerNorm/GELU/dropout, zero-initialized output
architecture.objective: SmoothAP listwise surrogate plus current-difficulty-weighted positive-negative pair loss, BCE, and residual L2
architecture.identity: zero residual exactly reproduces the current ranker

training.endpoint_rule: fixed 1500 steps for every seed and fold; no held-fold early stopping

frozen_internal_selection.rule: highest preregistered strength passing pooled, both-fold, both-sensor, matched-recall, and paired-site gates

gates.pass_action: fit the same two-seed endpoint on folds 3+4 and evaluate reused fold 2 once; success still requires later independent full-development cross-fitting

invariants: The exact current score cache, not its float16 feature copy, defines the residual floor and all comparisons.
The rejected end-to-end BCE residual feature is excluded.
Internal selection uses only folds 3 and 4; fold 2 cannot be evaluated until the selected strength is committed.
Every random module initialization and sampling generator is seed-bound.
No exact-paper or fresh external input is loaded.
Failure writes no artifact; any artifact remains Git-ignored.
